text: よわい　ポケモンでも　いっしょうけんめい　そだてれば　いいこと　あるさ！

structure.jp: よわい　ポケモンでも
いっしょうけんめい　そだてれば
structure.en: if you raise it with all your heart

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb ending to れば says 'if you do this'. そだてれば = 'if you raise it'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing means 'even' that thing. よわい　ポケモンでも = 'even a weak Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ at the end is a breezy, confident way to state something. いいこと　あるさ = 'good things will come, for sure'.
